Game Overview

Bumb Robot Escape is a platformer title where guide your robot through an endless journey, collecting coins while dodging monsters and rock formations. Outsmart adversaries that hurl nails your way and use acquired ammunition to clear your path. Test your reflexes in this thrilling run full of surprises and challenges.
